title: Analysis code: DNA methylation is spatially organised around, but does not instruct, the regulatory genome of Streptomyces coelicolor — a 4mC/6mA methylome with a same-strand AAGCCCG dual modification
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript DNA methylation is spatially organised around, but does not instruct, the regulatory genome of Streptomyces coelicolor: a 4mC/6mA methylome with a same-strand AAGCCCG dual modification (submitted to Nucleic Acids Research).

Nine biological samples of S. coelicolor A3(2) M145 across three developmental time points (12, 24 and 50 h; R5 liquid culture). Genomic DNA and total RNA were extracted from the same harvested culture per sample. Methylome: Oxford Nanopore MinION (FLO-MIN114 / SQK-RBK114-96), modification-tagged alignments to NC_003888.3 (6mA, 4mC, 5mC). Transcriptome: Illumina NovaSeq X Plus, strand-specific RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero Plus, NEBNext Ultra II Directional).

Sequencing data are deposited separately in the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (BioProject accession to be added). This record contains code, per-stage conda environment exports, result tables and figure-generation scripts only. Scripts hard-code absolute paths under the original author's home directory and must be adapted before running elsewhere; see README.
